Description:

Experienced engineers are sought for a cruise ship project in Nantong, China, offering a 3-year contract with potential for extension. Proficiency in classification society rules (ABS, DNV-GL, BV, IMO, SOLAS) and AutoCAD is essential, along with professional marine engineering English.
